title: AWS CloudTrail logging stopped or trail deleted
description: Detects successful AWS CloudTrail StopLogging or DeleteTrail management API writes with both error fields empty.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may stop CloudTrail logging or delete a trail to reduce future audit visibility in the affected AWS scope.
hypothesis.rationale: The operation affects one trail. Other trails, event history or independent exports may still retain visibility. The AWSCloudTrail source contract requires boolean management/read-only flags and string error fields; malformed or absent fixture values do not indicate success.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Detects an AWS management API write for the selected security-control removal operation with both error fields empty.

triage.summary: The operation affects one trail. Other trails, event history or independent exports may still retain visibility. The AWSCloudTrail source contract requires boolean management/read-only flags and string error fields; malformed or absent fixture values do not indicate success.
steps: Review the AWS account, region, actor ARN, source address and CloudTrail event identifier.
Inspect the affected security service's current configuration and independent regional or organizational coverage.
Validate the approved owner and change record, then investigate related identity and control-plane activity and restore coverage if unauthorized.
false_positives: Approved trail replacement, region consolidation or account decommissioning.

validation.expected_outcome: Match the bounded event, key/action/path or successful operation combination; reject one-field mutations, lookalikes and absent required fields. Synthetic tests do not establish live telemetry or production performance.

limitations: The operation affects one trail. Other trails, event history or independent exports may still retain visibility. The AWSCloudTrail source contract requires boolean management/read-only flags and string error fields; malformed or absent fixture values do not indicate success.
Current-revision evidence is synthetic only. Validate full generated KQL, source fields, ingestion delay, alert volume and scoped exclusions in the target before enabling.
